prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE original finished ultra-wide photographic banner for a designer's portfolio, 3:1 landscape, ideally 1536 x 512 pixels. This image is the banner artwork only, NOT a whole webpage, NOT a contact sheet. Full bleed, no outer margin, no rounded outer frame, no watermarks. Exceptional art-directed editorial product photography with realistic device mockups, correct device geometry and faithful interface branding. All major text and product features must fit within the center 88% of the image. The actual project interface described below is the authority for device screens. Creative scene photography is illustrative, not a claim about a real location, product outcome or study. Compact default PawFriend Pet adoption banner. Match the live project: warm cream #F5EDDE, black condensed extra-bold display type, tangerine orange, sky blue and tiny acid-lime accent. A friendly tan-and-white mixed-breed dog with one upright ear and one floppy ear, happy face, white nose blaze, like the project's Milo, at center against a sky-blue photographic backdrop. Left a compact black condensed all-caps heading 'NEW BEST FRIEND.' Right a single black phone showing the real responsive PawFriend website: black header with cream paw mark and exact 'PAWFRIEND' condensed wordmark, warm cream canvas, condensed black headline 'FIND YOUR NEW BEST FRIEND.', tan-and-white dog photo, black 'MEET THE PETS' action, tiny lime underline. Authentic affectionate pet photography, crisp flat brand colors, no peach generic app, no retriever substituted for the actual visual concept. Wide strip readable at 450 x 110px.
